description: Use official MicroG-RE 7.3.0 for Google Maps and synthesized navigation speech, start Google TTS before guidance, skip the uncertified-device screen and avoid a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open. Includes an opt-in Picture-in-picture setting in Maps Settings. Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer.

patches.name: BYD navigation audio routing
patches.description: Routes navigation prompts to the BYD-specific audio stream when supported, retaining the original fallback. Not needed on phones.

patches.name: Device certification fix
patches.description: Skips the uncertified-device screen that closes Maps on devices Google does not certify.

patches.name: Google Maps for MicroG-RE
patches.description: Connects supported Google Maps builds to MicroG-RE 7.3.0 and avoids a crash when a location-settings dialog cannot open.

patches.name: Navigation speech and TTS startup
patches.description: Prefers synthesized navigation speech, keeping the existing audio fallback, and starts Google TTS when Maps opens.

patches.name: Picture-in-picture setting
patches.description: Adds a Picture-in-picture On/Off setting to Maps Settings. Turn it off so navigation does not open a small window when you leave Maps; it starts on, as in Maps. Hooks inspected on Maps 26.41 and 26.42.

release_notes:
- Uses official MicroG-RE 7.3.0.
- Removes **BYD native battery experiment**. For BYD EVs, use [Google Maps Automotive for MicroG-RE](https://github.com/fangkampanat/google-maps-automotive-patches) (Maps Car). **BYD navigation audio routing** stays.
- Requires Morphe Desktop 1.19.0 or newer. Restart Desktop before patching another APK.

Tested on Maps `26.43.05.1002020710` on an Android 16 phone with the default patches and MicroG-RE 7.3.0.
